localizations.whatsNew:
• 新增微信登录与账号绑定，支持关联 Apple 账号，换设备或换平台继续使用同一账号。
• 新增「我的记录」，可关联用过的名字，集中查看自己参赛的记录。
• 新增记录云端同步，登录同一账号即可在不同设备查看记录与备注。
• 九球追分新增「赛事积分」赛制及 14710、1357 分值方案，完善开球设置与规则说明。
• 优化语音播报，支持中英文切换，英文播报可将中文姓名读成拼音。
• 扫码支持从相册识别二维码，改进加入小组与网页扫码登录体验。
• 优化计分板布局、掼蛋操作和投篮训练手势，提升稳定性，修复已知问题。

• Introducing My Records: link names you’ve used and view the matches you played in one place.
• Added cloud sync for records and notes across devices signed in to the same account.
• Added Tournament Points mode and 14710 / 1357 scoring presets for nine-ball, with improved break settings and rule guides.
• Improved voice announcements, including pinyin pronunciation for Chinese names in English announcements.
• Added QR code scanning from photos and improved group joining and web sign-in.
• Refined scoreboard layouts, Guandan controls and basketball shooting practice gestures, with stability improvements and bug fixes.
